title: Understanding the Model Equation
text: The model equation given is $$self_{rating}=\theta_0+\theta_1 critic_1$$. This equation is used to predict the $$self_{rating}$$ based on the value of $$critic_1$$.

title: Effect of Squaring $$critic_1$$
text: If we use the square of $$critic_1$$ as the predictor variable, the model equation becomes $$self_{rating}=\theta_0+\theta_1 {critic_1}^2$$.

title: Impact on $$\theta_1$$
text: Changing the predictor variable from $$critic_1$$ to $${critic_1}^2$$ will affect the value of $$\theta_1$$ because the relationship between the predictor and the response variable changes.
